Hamare Green Park ka kya hoga bhai?

data.asar: UP walo ko match dekhne dusre state nahi jana hoga.
data.caption:
Banaras ke cricket fans ke liye badi khushkhabri aa gayi hai! 🏏🔥

🏟️ Varanasi ke Ganjari mein ban raha stadium lagbhag taiyar ho chuka hai.
📊 Mandlayukt ke mutabiq stadium ka 98% kaam pura ho gaya hai.
🗓️ Finishing ka sara kaam 30 November tak pura karne ka target hai.
🤝 ICC Chairman Jay Shah ne bhi stadium ka dora karke taiyari dekhi.

Ab bas pitch par Rohit-Virat aur stand mein Banarasi paan chahiye, mahol set ho jayega! 😋

Apne cricket premi dosto ko ye story share karo aur batao: Kashi mein pehla match kiska hona chahiye?
